title: Wrist watch
author: a.aazhgirevich

changes: Maker logo mesh and all dial text meshes removed (unbranded); dial printed ring removed; 5 exporter-split bezel pieces joined; re-scaled (bezel radius 0.98) and re-centred; hour/minute/seconds hands rotated to 12 for live time; parts renamed by role; original materials replaced in code (steel, gold, leather, glass, printed dial); case/strap/crown/buckle/glass simplified with meshoptimizer (bezel kept full); quantized + meshopt-compressed GLB (1.88 MB). Same file on desktop and phone.
